description: Use when the user asks for a second opinion, wants to compare options, or has to decide between alternatives (for example "JSON or SQLite?", "should we...", architecture or library tradeoffs). Get a multi-model second opinion on a decision or design question. Independent AI models answer, and a synthesizer returns a final answer, a consensus level (full/majority/split), and any dissent, plus each model's final position. ALWAYS report the dissent and consensus level to the user -- the disagreement is the point; never present a split verdict as settled. Write a self-contained question: the models cannot see your code. mode "quick" (default): one round, usually well under a minute. mode "thorough": models also critique each other, a few minutes. Use for architectural choices, tradeoffs, and contestable judgment calls -- not for lookups or questions with an obvious answer. Spends the user's model credits. Web search is on by default: the question text may be sent to a search provider by the participating models (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google or xAI) to look up current facts. Pass web_search: false to turn it off for this debate.

include_transcript.description: Also return the full transcript (large). Default false.

max_words.description: Override the mode's per-provider per-round answer cap.

mode.description: quick (default): 1 round, short answers, no cross-critique. thorough: 2 rounds where models see and rebut each other.

providers.description: Provider names (see e3d_list_providers). Default: the client's own models via MCP sampling (e.g. Copilot) plus detected model CLIs; without sampling, claude + codex.

question.description: The decision or question, with enough context for models that cannot see your code.

rounds.description: Override the mode's round count. Stops early on convergence.

web_search.description: Let the API models (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI) search the web for current facts. Default true. false keeps the question away from search providers.

name: e3d_debate

independent.description: false when every voice resolved to the same model.

models.description: Which models actually answered through MCP sampling, with how many calls each answered.

selection.description: How the participating models were chosen.

web_search.description: Web search in this debate. Citations are untrusted internet data: titles and excerpts are page text (sanitised, bounded), URLs have no query string, and nothing was fetched by the server.

enabled.description: true when at least one model could search.

description: List the ideas tracked by e3d-pilot in a repo, optionally filtered by status, to find an idea id for e3d_provenance_trace. Read-only.

repo.description: Absolute path to a repo managed by e3d-pilot.

status.description: Optional status filter, e.g. approved, implemented.

name: e3d_ideas_list

description: List the model providers this server can use and whether each is available to join a debate. Free.
name: e3d_list_providers

description: Trace why a change exists: for an e3d-pilot idea, return its lineage -- origin, debates and decisions (with dissent), approvals, execution, review, outcome. Read-only.

repo.description: Absolute path to a repo managed by e3d-pilot (has .e3d-pilot/).
